recordHint: Record a voice message: click, or hold while you talk ({{shortcut}})

notices.denied: Linkord isn't allowed to use the microphone. Allow it in the site settings (the icon next to the address) and try again.
notices.busy: Couldn't open the microphone. Another app may be using it, such as a call in Discord or Meet.
notices.tooShort: Recording too short. Click to record, or hold the button while you talk.
notices.inCall: You're in a call. Leave it to record a voice message.
notices.callStarted: Recording stopped because you joined a call. It's ready to review.
notices.silent: We're not picking up any sound from the microphone. It may be muted or in use by another app.
notices.otherCall: You're in a call in another tab or device: if its microphone is open, the people in that call hear you too.
